module_summary: Multiplexes four UDP frame sources onto one output: an arbiter picks a source, a frame flag latches its header into output registers, and payload passes through a skid-buffered AXI-stream register.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Two-state frame-in-progress flag; set at header accept, cleared on last payload beat.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Arbiter index selecting which source's header fields and payload stream reach the output.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter has a granted source; gates header latch and payload valid/ready.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector from arbiter; masks request and drives header ready.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request: header valid of sources not already granted.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant when granted source transfers its last payload beat.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-source header valid; forms arbiter requests.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-source header ready, pulsed to granted source at frame start.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid; must be accepted before a new frame header is latched.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready; clears header valid and allows next header latch.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Representative output header field register, loaded from granted source at frame start.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated per-source payload data, sliced by grant_encoded.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-source payload valid; selected one feeds internal valid and acknowledge.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready routed only to the granted source.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from the output register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from output valid register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; steers output vs temp register storage.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready of skid buffer; gates source ready and storage decisions.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output payload data register loaded from mux or temp register.

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding a beat when output is stalled.

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupied flag; affects early ready and temp-to-output transfer.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output payload registers from the selected input.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads temp registers when output is stalled.

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register contents into output registers.

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Payload data of the granted source after the input mux.

groups.name: Source arbiter
groups.description: Arbiter instance granting one source per frame, released on last payload beat.

groups.name: Frame controller
groups.description: Frame flag and header handshakes; latches header at frame start, waits for tlast.

groups.name: Header output registers
groups.description: Ethernet/IP/UDP header field registers muxed from the granted source.

groups.name: Payload input mux
groups.description: Selects granted source payload stream into internal AXI-stream signals.

groups.name: Payload skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers with registered ready decoupling payload backpressure.
